title: It’s great
text: It’s great. Wanted something to put my “stuff” in that junked up my table and floor in the living room. This fit the bill. Perfect.

product_metadata.title: Greenco Faux Leather Tufted Ottoman Stool, Square Ottoman Storage Cube, Seat and Foot Rest, Collapsible and Versatile Black Storage Box
features: Multiuse - This tufted, nail-headed storage cube is perfect for organizing and storing clothes, games, toys, art supplies, and so much more! The multi-purpose ottoman offers ample storage with an easy open & close top.

Perfect for Any Décor - This black faux leather storage stool works with many types of home décor and is a great accent piece in the living room, den, bedroom, etc. It also can be used for extra seating or as a foot stool/ rest.
Convenient Storage - Keep clutter under control by storing all of your clothing and accessories in one convenient place. The easy to assemble ottoman collapses flat for easy storage when not in use.
High-Quality - Made of durable, easy to clean, waterproof, black faux leather built to last for many years of use. Dimensions: 14” H x 14” W x 14” L. Weight capacity of up to 250lb.
description: This Ottoman Stool is an ideal addition to your living room, playroom, dorm room etc. Its versatile use as a storage box for clothes to games, toys, art & craft supplies and more. Also for an extra seat whenever needed. Its tufted high cushioned seats makes it as comfortable as it gets! with adding style to its design!. Easy to set up when using and collapses flat when not in use for easy storage. Dimensions in inches; 14” H x 14” W x 14” L. Weight capacity of up to 250 lb.
